title: Hypocoercive Langevin dynamics on the Lie group $\mathrm{SE}(2)$
summary: We consider a Langevin-type diffusion on the planar motion group $\mathrm{SE}(2)$, describing the coupled evolution of position and orientation with degenerate noise acting only in the rotational direction. Although hypocoercivity for related models on $\mathbb{R}^2 \times \mathbb{S}^1$ is well understood, our purpose is to present an intrinsic formulation on the Lie group $\mathrm{SE}(2)$, and to highlight the underlying geometric mechanism.
